sidebar.$description: The app's primary navigation — the brand-blue panel on the left of every CX page (Dashboard, Advising, Advisor, Class Information…). Built 2026-10-15 from the live HighPoint CX sidebar, restyled: same structure (logo, flat links, collapsible groups with nested links, a count on a group, the signed-in person at the foot) but on the DS grid and roles. What changed from the live one: an open group no longer turns into a white panel with dark text — its children stay on the blue, indented under the parent's label, and only the CURRENT page wears the white pill; the group header doesn't get a black outline when open; hover is one surface step (brandHover), not a darker band. Two themes — brand blue (default) and neutral gray (.sidebar--neutral). Three shapes on one recipe: expanded (default, 288px), collapsed rail (64px — icons only, labels in a Tooltip), and on a phone the expanded panel as a left Drawer behind the topbar's menu button. Deferred: section headings inside the nav, drag-to-reorder, search-in-nav — the live app has none of them.

width.$description: 288px expanded — at 256 the longest live labels ('Graduation Processing' beside its chevron, 'Appointment Campaigns', 'Setup Deg Progress Exceptions') ellipsized at 14px.

collapsedWidth.$description: 64px rail: the 40px item centred in 12px side padding.

padding.$description: Panel inset around the item list (12px). Items are full-width inside it.

gap.$description: Between items (2px) — enough that two hovered/active pills never touch.

divider.$description: Under the header and above the account footer.

height.$description: 64px — the same height as every app shell's topbar, so the logo row and the topbar line up.
40px — the control height used everywhere else; also the touch target in the phone drawer.

label.$description: 14px regular. The current page goes semibold (activeLabel).

activeLabel.$description: The current page: body-base's 14px at semibold — the same size as every other item. (Was text-style.heading-sm, which is 12px: the selected item rendered SMALLER than the rest — fixed 2026-10-19.)

childIndent.$description: 44px = item paddingX 12 + icon 20 + gap 12: a nested link's text starts exactly under its parent's label.

text.$description: Nested links rest a step quieter than top-level ones; hover brings them to white.

active.$description: The current page: a white pill with brand text — the one loud thing in the panel (kept from the live app).

focused.$description: border.focus is blue.600 — invisible on a blue.700 panel. The ring on this surface is white, 2px, inset.

count.$description: A group's count (Advisor · 3) shows only while the group is CLOSED — open, its children carry their own counts and the header's total would repeat them (user, 2026-10-19); in the rail it stays as a dot. It is Counter sm in its onPrimary ACTIVE colours (white chip, brand text) — the onPrimary inactive chip is fill.primaryActive (blue.700), the same colour as this panel, so it would vanish.

account.$description: The signed-in person at the foot: Avatar sm + name + chevron (opens a Menu: profile, sign out). Same row recipe as an item, taller for the avatar.

height.$description: 56px — Avatar sm (32) with 12px above and below.

neutral.$description: The gray variant (.sidebar--neutral), added 2026-10-19: the same recipe on surface.dim (gray.50 — lighter than the first cut's gray.100, still a step under the gray.25 page) with dark text and a hairline right edge. Hover is the wash tier (fill.neutralHover); the white current-page pill gets a border.default hairline. Counter onNeutral active still reads on gray.50. The current page is the same white pill with brand text as on blue. Focus goes back to the system ring (border.focus) — it's visible on gray. Counts are Counter onNeutral ACTIVE (brand blue chip, white label) — the onNeutral pair exists exactly for chips on gray.100. The logo keeps its normal colours.

bg.$description: gray.50 — a step lighter than the first cut's gray.100 (user, 2026-10-19: 'a bit lighter, but still darker than the page'); still one step under the gray.25 page.

hoverBg.$description: Wash tier (gray.100): on a gray.50 panel the Strong tier (gray.200) was heavier than the hover needs.

activeBorder.$description: A hairline round the white current-page pill — white on gray.50 is too close to read as a shape on its own.

edge.$description: The panel's right edge: gray.50 against the gray.25 page needs the hairline to read as a column.
